acceptance: Each rewrite has dialect tests including the nested-parentheses CTE case that the regex mishandles.
Real-engine proof: generated SQL executes on a QuestDB container in the fork CI (F0b); if the container cannot run there, the gap is recorded and sign-off requested before merge.
Output differences versus questdb_rewriter.py over tests/unit/platforms/test_questdb_rewriter*.py inputs are listed in the PR.
New dialect files may be status 'original'; edits to upstream-owned files are carried patches. Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PR merged.
description: Replace benchbox/platforms/questdb_rewriter.py (three regexes and one AST rewrite) with a QuestDB dialect generator: comma joins to explicit joins, INTERVAL +/- n DAY/MONTH/YEAR to dateadd('d'|'M'|'y', ...), SUBSTRING FROM/FOR to the supported form, and WITH name(cols) AS to the supported form. The AST version must handle nested parentheses, which the current CTE regex does not. QuestDB is a fork-original dialect; the upstream feature request draft stays in _project/sqlglot-upstream/issues/06-questdb-dialect-feature-request.md.
